ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below schematically shows a geological and geomorphological map of a certain region in China; the four locations 1, 2, 3, and 4 are located in different strata. <image1> What hydrological phenomenon will mainly occur in normal years in the Yellow River section shown in the figure?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, labels such as “Helan Mountain,” “Yinchuan Plain,” and “Yellow River” can be seen. The Yellow River is located near the east side of the Yinchuan Plain, indicating that the river section shown is the Yellow River section in the area of the Yinchuan Plain in Ningxia. Below the figure there are also four stratum positions, 1, 2, 3, and 4, but this question asks about the hydrological phenomenon of this Yellow River section. Then reason: Ningxia Yinchuan is located in the temperate continental climate zone of northern China, with relatively low temperatures in winter. In normal years, the river water will cool down in winter and a freezing or freeze-up phenomenon will occur. Therefore, the Yellow River section shown in the figure will mainly have a freezing phenomenon in normal years.
